note: Synthetic, fictional, non-personal sentences (invented companies, places and names). Written 2026-11-05 before any live call. Passages are first-person as recall sees them; day = days after a fixed origin, so recency is testable.

passages.text: We closed a seed round of $3M led by Larkspur Ventures.
Two angel investors joined the cap table last week.
We are starting conversations for our Series A next quarter.
My goal is to finish the Oakridge half marathon.
I crossed the finish line at Oakridge in under two hours!
I want to get my pilot's licence by summer.
I gave up on the pilot's licence; the lessons were too expensive.
Our office is in Leeds, near the station.
We moved the office to Bristol in March.
Priya leads our design team.
Priya left the company; Tomas now runs design.
The product launch is planned for May 12.
The launch slipped to June 2 because of a supplier delay.
I bought a release valve for the boiler.
The round table in the kitchen needs a new leg.
The goal posts at the park were repainted.
I baked sourdough bread this morning.
The weather was sunny all weekend.
I repainted the garden fence blue.
My cat sleeps on the windowsill most afternoons.
I watched a documentary about volcanoes.
The train was ten minutes late today.
I'm learning a few chords on the ukulele.
We planted tomatoes in the backyard.
